messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build and extend a 2D chess-themed arcade boss fight where the player controls a king with a shotgun against the Omni Rook.

## Requirements
- User’s latest request: “Add mobile controls also make the omni rook have a rainbow trail and color also add parry technique and add more attacks for omni rook”.
- Original game request also required a complete, playable game without clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Interpreted “2D chess” as a chessboard-themed arcade boss fight, not standard chess rules.
- Mobile controls use an on-screen joystick plus fire and parry buttons; desktop parry uses Shift.

## Work State
### Completed
- Initial playable game implemented in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`: movement, shotgun, boss telegraphs/attacks, health, ammo/reload, lives, score, pause, sound, restart/victory.
- Added touch-control UI and styling, plus mobile joystick/fire/parry event handlers.
- Added a parry mechanic with a timed window, cooldown UI, reflected-hit reward/damage, and Shift binding.
- Expanded Omni Rook attack selection with line, burst, cross, aimed, and spiral types, distributed by boss phase.

### Active
- Finish integrating the new parry and attack logic into the game update loop and visuals.
- Add the requested rainbow boss color and trail.
- Verify controls and gameplay in-browser, check for console/runtime errors, and fix issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Continue editing `game.js`: complete attack phase resolution, parry-window collision/reflection, stun handling, spiral homing shots, and update timers/UI.
2. Draw the Omni Rook with animated rainbow colors and its moving rainbow trail.
3. Run `node --check game.js`, inspect/test the game in-browser and take a screenshot; fix any issues.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: gameplay, input handling, parry, boss attacks, rendering; currently mid-edit.
- `index.html`: added mobile controls and updated control/help copy.
- `style.css`: mobile control layout and touch-action styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Existing browser testing used `http://localhost:3002`; an initial screenshot showed the game and start state. No browser check has yet been performed after the latest edits.
- The previous `game.js` update loop still handles only `tell`, `dash`, and `recover` attack phases; newly introduced `cross`, `aimed`, and `spiral` types need their respective firing logic.

## Objective
- Extend the existing chess-themed arcade boss fight with mobile controls, a rainbow Omni Rook and trail, a parry mechanic, and more boss attacks.

## Requirements
- Add mobile controls, rainbow boss colors and trail, parry, and additional Omni Rook attacks.

## Decisions
- Mobile controls use a virtual joystick plus Fire and Parry buttons.
- Parry is also bound to Shift on desktop.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added mobile touch controls and responsive styling.
- Added a timed parry window, cooldown indicator, reflected projectiles, stun, and bonus damage.
- Added Cross, Aimed, and Spiral attacks alongside existing Line and Burst attacks.
- Added animated rainbow coloring and a fading rainbow trail for the Omni Rook.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed; desktop and mobile Chromium screenshots were captured.

### Active
- Verify gameplay interactions after starting a run, including mobile input, parry timing, attack resolution, and browser console/runtime errors.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run the game in-browser and verify controls, parry/reflection, and each attack type.
2. Fix any issues found during interactive testing.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: gameplay, touch/keyboard input, parry, boss attacks, and rendering.
- `index.html`: touch-control markup and control/help text.
- `style.css`: mobile control layout and responsive styling.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The game is served at `http://localhost:3002`; screenshots were saved to `/tmp/opencode/checkmate.png` and `/tmp/opencode/checkmate-mobile.png`.
- The screenshots show the initial page; interactive gameplay has not yet been verified after the latest changes.
